reviews.text: We have a new dog!! Our 18 month old Rottie was chasing cars, jumping and snarling at the window, and just being a big bully everyday. It came to a point I couldn’t even take him on a walk. Prentice showed us exactly how to show him who’s in charge with tools and smarts, not anger or aggression. We learned all the skills to stay one step ahead of all his reactive behavior and now I’m fully confident I am equipped to have a well trained dog for his entire life! Prentice’s knowledge blew me away and I am grateful for getting this training!

Words cant describe how grateful I am for Prentice. My chow chow Todd had attacked my dad multiple times. The last attack was so bad that we were considering putting him down, but I didnt want to give up on the dog. Thank God my cousin Olivia recommended me to Prentice. He taught me so much about dog psychology and we were able to get Todd back in line, sleep in a crate, and become the best dog I have ever had. After the training  we put Todd through, he never bit or even snapped at another person and lived the rest of his years in peace. I couldnt recommend Prentice more. He really changed me and my dogs life.

The owner Prentice Kidd has been working with my 179lbs 15 month African Boerboel Suh’Bae. He kept her for me for five days. His training and boarding was unmatched. My girl was happy, energetic and well mannered when I returned. I can tell she was well taken care of. I would definitely refer him to train or board other dogs.

I could never take my dog in public before and now we just met at the Home Depot and had a 2 hour training session and I was able to buy my things without her even moving while told to sit in the checkout line.

I got a pup in December and had no idea the responsibility, time, and effort it takes to train a dog. Prentice gave me the knowledge and tools necessary to adjust to being a dog owner. I look forward to continuing to work with him to advance my German Shepherd.
